title: Await telemetry drainer completion during explicit IndexManager shutdown
outcome: Await telemetry drainer completion during explicit IndexManager shutdown
acceptance: A deterministic delayed-drainer regression proves ShutdownAsync remains incomplete until the telemetry drainer completes.
After ShutdownAsync returns, telemetry holds no delete-denying workspace file handle and immediate workspace deletion succeeds.
The existing bounded synchronous Dispose behavior remains unchanged.

completion.summary: Implemented explicit telemetry-drainer joining in IndexManager asynchronous shutdown while preserving bounded synchronous Dispose. Added deterministic delayed-writer, blocked-startup, blocked-refresh-pump, watcher, lease, successor-writer, and immediate-deletion contracts. Same original Codex reviewer empirically verified the prior High fixed.
